name: vincentragosta/todaytix-calendar
description: A framework-agnostic TodayTix availability engine plus a WordPress (Mythus + IX) ticket-calendar block. Renders per-performance availability (available / limited / sold out) off the TodayTix white-label feed.

suggest.vincentragosta/mythus: Needed by the WordPress layer (Provider/Service/Endpoint). The consuming theme already provides it.
suggest.vincentragosta/ix: Needed by the IX theme Provider bridge and the block asset build pipeline. The consuming theme already provides it.
